title: Stories from the Pentamerone
author: Giambattista Basile
description: "Stories from the Pentamerone" by Giambattista Basile is a fairy tale collection published posthumously in 1634 and 1636.
longDescription: This groundbreaking work presents fifty Neapolitan tales told over five days through an elaborate frame story about a cursed princess who cannot laugh.

authorInfo.bio: Giambattista Basile (–1632) wrote Stories from the Pentamerone. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
